userSpecifiedSources: Baseball Savant (MLB Advanced Media), https://baseballsavant.mlb.com/leaderboard/ : Pitch Arsenal Stats, Pitch Arsenals, Pitch Movement and Pitcher Arm Angle leaderboards, 2020-2026 regular seasons; Pitch Movement and Arm Angle through savant-extras 0.6.0 (https://pypi.org/project/savant-extras/). Built by build.py in https://github.com/yasumorishima/kaggle-datasets (pitcher-arsenal-dataset), which publishes nothing unless every gate passes.

pitcher_arsenal.csv.description: One row per pitcher, regular season and pitch type, 2020-2026: usage, outcomes (run value, whiff%, K%, put-away%, xwOBA) from Savant's Pitch Arsenal Stats, speed, spin, break and release point from Savant's Pitch Arsenals, and break compared with similar pitches from Savant's Pitch Movement.

columns.pitcher_id: MLB Advanced Media (MLBAM) player ID of the pitcher.
columns.player_name: Pitcher name as Baseball Savant lists it (Last, First).
columns.team: Team abbreviation Savant lists for the season; for a pitcher who changed teams, the team he finished with. Savant uses current abbreviations (the Athletics are ATH in every season).
columns.pitch_type: Statcast pitch type: FF four-seam, SI sinker, FC cutter, SL slider, ST sweeper, SV slurve, CU curveball (Savant's arsenal pages count knuckle curves as CU), CH changeup, FS splitter, FO forkball, SC screwball, KN knuckleball.
columns.pitches: Pitches of this type thrown in the regular season (empty for rows with in_arsenal_stats = False).
columns.total_pitches: All regular-season pitches of the pitcher.
columns.usage_pct: Share of the pitcher's pitches that were this type, in percent (0-100).
columns.pa: Plate appearances that ended on this pitch type.
columns.run_value: Run value of the pitch type (pitcher's view: positive = runs saved), rounded as Savant shows it.
columns.run_value_per_100: Run value per 100 pitches of this type.
columns.whiff_pct: Whiff rate in percent (Savant's whiff%): whiffs / swings, where whiffs are swinging strikes and foul tips.
columns.k_pct: Strikeouts per plate appearance ending on this pitch type, in percent.
columns.put_away_pct: Two-strike pitches of this type that produced a strikeout, in percent.
columns.ba: Batting average against, on plate appearances ending on this pitch type.
columns.hard_hit_pct: Batted balls hit 95 mph or harder, in percent.
columns.launch_angle_avg: Average launch angle of batted balls, degrees.
columns.exit_velocity_avg: Average exit velocity of batted balls, mph.
columns.barrel_pct: Barrels per batted ball, in percent.
columns.in_arsenal_stats: True if the row is in Savant's Pitch Arsenal Stats leaderboard. False = the pitch was thrown but no plate appearance ended on it, so it is only on the Pitch Arsenals page: usage, speed, spin and break are filled, pitches and the outcome columns are empty.
columns.break_x: Average horizontal break in inches, from the catcher's view: negative = toward third base (arm side of a right-hander), positive = toward first base (Statcast pfx_x x 12).
columns.break_z: Average vertical break in inches including gravity (negative = drop).
columns.break_z_induced: Average induced vertical break in inches (gravity removed; Statcast pfx_z x 12).
columns.release_x: Average horizontal release point, feet (catcher's view).
columns.break_x_vs_similar: Horizontal break compared with pitches of the same type at similar speed and release, inches (Savant Pitch Movement 'break vs avg'; positive = more horizontal break). Only for pitchers Savant's Pitch Movement leaderboard lists.
columns.break_z_vs_similar: Vertical break compared with pitches of the same type at similar speed and release, inches, in the pitch's own direction: for FF and FC positive = less drop (more 'rise'), for other types positive = more drop. Only for pitchers Savant's Pitch Movement leaderboard lists.
columns.break_x_vs_similar_pctile: Percentile (0-1) of break_x_vs_similar among pitchers of this type in the season.
columns.break_z_vs_similar_pctile: Percentile (0-1) of break_z_vs_similar among pitchers of this type in the season.

columns.n_pitch_types: Number of pitch types with a row in pitcher_arsenal.csv.
columns.usage_pct_sum: Sum of usage_pct over those pitch types. Close to 100; lower when the pitcher threw types Savant's arsenal pages do not list (eephus, pitchouts, unclassified).
columns.pitch_hand: Throwing hand (R/L) from Savant's Pitch Arsenals page; S for a pitcher listed with both; empty when the pitcher is not on that page (position players who pitched, and pitchers with fewer than 10 pitches).
columns.arm_angle: Arm angle in degrees (Savant Pitcher Arm Angle leaderboard; only for the pitchers it lists).

arsenal_changes.csv.description: Year-over-year arsenal changes: one row per pitcher, season and pitch type for pitchers who pitched in both the season and the one before, covering every type thrown in either season, with previous value, current value and change.

columns.pitcher_id: MLB Advanced Media (MLBAM) player ID of the pitcher.
columns.player_name: Pitcher name (Last, First), as listed in his latest season.
columns.season: The later of the two seasons compared.
columns.pitch_type: Statcast pitch type: FF four-seam, SI sinker, FC cutter, SL slider, ST sweeper, SV slurve, CU curveball (Savant's arsenal pages count knuckle curves as CU), CH changeup, FS splitter, FO forkball, SC screwball, KN knuckleball.
columns.is_new: True if the pitch type was not thrown in prev_season. A pitch Savant reclassified (for example a slider relabelled sweeper) shows as one new and one dropped type.
columns.is_dropped: True if the pitch type was thrown in prev_season but not in season.
columns.usage_pct_prev: Usage in percent (0 when the pitch was not thrown that season) in prev_season.
columns.usage_pct: Usage in percent (0 when the pitch was not thrown that season) in season.
columns.usage_pct_delta: Change in usage in percent: season minus prev_season.
columns.avg_speed_delta: Change in average speed, mph: season minus prev_season.
columns.avg_spin_delta: Change in average spin, rpm: season minus prev_season.
columns.break_x_prev: Average horizontal break, inches (catcher's view) in prev_season.
columns.break_x: Average horizontal break, inches (catcher's view) in season.
columns.break_x_delta: Change in average horizontal break, inches: season minus prev_season.
columns.break_z_induced_prev: Average induced vertical break, inches in prev_season.
columns.break_z_induced: Average induced vertical break, inches in season.
columns.break_z_induced_delta: Change in average induced vertical break, inches: season minus prev_season.
columns.whiff_pct_prev: Whiff rate in percent in prev_season.
columns.whiff_pct: Whiff rate in percent in season.
columns.whiff_pct_delta: Change in whiff rate in percent: season minus prev_season.
columns.run_value_per_100_prev: Run value per 100 pitches in prev_season.
columns.run_value_per_100: Run value per 100 pitches in season.
columns.run_value_per_100_delta: Change in run value per 100 pitches: season minus prev_season.
